summary: DBHub is a database MCP server for Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MariaDB, SQLite. Prior to...
description: DBHub is a database MCP server for Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MariaDB, SQLite. Prior to 0.22.6, read-only SQL validation can be bypassed on the MySQL and MariaDB connectors. In `src/utils/sql-parser.ts`, `scanSingleLineComment` treats every double dash as a comment start, whereas MySQL and MariaDB require following whitespace, a control character, or the end of the line. The read-only check in `src/tools/execute-sql.ts` validates split statements with `isReadOnlySQL`, but `src/connectors/mysql/index.ts` and `src/connectors/mariadb/index.ts` execute the original string with `multipleStatements` enabled. A double dash followed by a non-whitespace character can therefore hide a subsequent write or destructive DDL statement from the validator while the database interprets the dashes as minus operators and executes both statements. Anyone able to influence the assistant's SQL, including through prompt injection in content the assistant reads, can bypass read-only mode to modify or drop database data, subject to the database account's privileges. PostgreSQL is not affected by this path because its double-dash parsing agrees with the checker and its connector executes individual split statements. This issue is fixed in version 0.22.6.

summary: The Tenda W18E web management server is vulnerable to OS command injection via the "diagnose"...
description: The Tenda W18E web management server is vulnerable to OS command injection via the "diagnose" packet-capture feature due to improper validation of JSON fields. An authenticated user can inject shell metacharacters into the protocol or targetDevice fields, which are later concatenated into a tcpdump command and executed with root privileges. This vulnerability can be exploited without authentication if the device is in a factory-reset state.

summary:
RTIR's ticket creation forms show the subject of the related
      ticket when splitting a ticket...
description:
RTIR's ticket creation forms show the subject of the related
      ticket when splitting a ticket or creating an incident from a
      report, and they render that subject without HTML escaping. A
      ticket subject containing script runs it when a user opens either
      form. RTIR grants everyone the right to create Incident Reports by
      default, so an unauthenticated sender of an emailed report can set
      that subject. The script then runs in the session of the incident
      handler who creates an incident from the report or splits it, and
      can act in RT with that user's authority. 


The issue was fixed in version 6.0.4. RTIR 5.0 is not
      affected.

summary:
RTIR extends RT's HTML scrubber to allow an internal link
      placeholder, and the extension...
description:
RTIR extends RT's HTML scrubber to allow an internal link
      placeholder, and the extension lets through any link that merely
      contains the placeholder, including links using the executable
      javascript: scheme. The change applies to the whole RT instance
      once RTIR is installed, not only to RTIR's own queues. Anyone who
      can add HTML content to a ticket on such an instance can store
      such a link. That includes an unauthenticated sender of HTML email
      to the Incident Reports queue, which RTIR opens to everyone by
      default. Script runs when a user clicks the link, in that user's
      session, and can act in RT with that user's authority.


This issue was fixed in version 5.0.11 and 6.0.4

summary:
RT's automatic link creation for URLs in HTML ticket content does
      not HTML-escape the URL...
description:
RT's automatic link creation for URLs in HTML ticket content does
      not HTML-escape the URL it places in the link. A URL crafted to
      break out of the link's address can add a script that runs when the
      ticket history is displayed, with no further action by the viewer.
      Anyone who can add HTML content to a ticket can plant it. That
      includes an unauthenticated sender of HTML email to any queue that
      grants CreateTicket or ReplyToTicket to Everyone, which is routine
      for a queue that accepts mail from the public. The script runs in
      the session of any user who views the ticket, and can act in RT
      with that user's authority.


This issue was fixed in version 5.0.11 and 6.0.4

summary: Scribus before 1.6.7 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the Mac PICT image loader...
description: Scribus before 1.6.7 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the Mac PICT image loader and import plugin when unpacking 4-bit indexed pixel data. Attackers can supply a crafted PICT file with inconsistent width and row data that, when placed or imported, writes out of bounds, causing crashes or code execution.

summary: Scribus before 1.6.7 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the importdrw Micrografx...
description: Scribus before 1.6.7 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the importdrw Micrografx Draw plugin that uses an unvalidated y offset to select image scanlines. Attackers can craft a DRW file that, when imported by a user, writes decoded bitmap data outside the heap image buffer, causing crashes or code execution.

summary: Scribus before 1.6.7 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in the scimgdataloader_tiff TIFF...
description: Scribus before 1.6.7 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in the scimgdataloader_tiff TIFF loader that allows attackers to trigger a heap overflow via crafted tile dimensions. Attackers can supply a tiled TIFF with large tile width, height and sample values for a user to import, corrupting heap memory to crash Scribus or execute code.

summary: Scribus before 1.6.7 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the PICT image loader and...
description: Scribus before 1.6.7 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the PICT image loader and import plugin that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by supplying an unchecked bytesPerLine value. Attackers can craft a PICT file whose bytesPerLine exceeds the QImage scanline size, so placing or importing it crashes Scribus and may execute code as the user.

summary: Scribus before 1.6.7 contains an out-of-bounds memory access vulnerability in the importsvm...
description: Scribus before 1.6.7 contains an out-of-bounds memory access vulnerability in the importsvm plugin that fails to verify bitmap and transparency mask dimensions match. Attackers can supply a crafted SVM file with mismatched mask dimensions to trigger heap reads and writes, causing crashes or code execution as the user.

summary: Scribus before 1.6.7 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Mac PICT image loader...
description: Scribus before 1.6.7 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Mac PICT image loader and import plugin when decoding planar pixel data. Attackers can supply a crafted PICT file with manipulated dimensions that, when placed or imported, causes heap over-reads leading to crashes or heap memory disclosure.

summary: Scribus before 1.6.7 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the scimgdataloader_psd...
description: Scribus before 1.6.7 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the scimgdataloader_psd loader that uses unchecked PSD file values as lookup array indexes. Attackers can convince users to place or import a crafted PSD file to corrupt heap memory, causing crashes and potentially code execution as the user.

summary: An improper access control vulnerability exists in the multi-factor authentication (MFA)...
description: An improper access control vulnerability exists in the multi-factor authentication (MFA) functionality of ManageEngine SharePoint Manager Plus (SPMP). A low-privileged authenticated user can bypass authorization checks to read and modify MFA configuration settings, enable or disable MFA for the application, enumerate MFA-enrolled users, and delete MFA-enrolled accounts. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to weaken authentication protections or cause a denial of service by configuring invalid MFA settings, potentially locking legitimate users out of the application. This vulnerability was fixed in build 4507. The reproduction explicitly uses build 4506.

description: Tamery (formerly Conar) 0.26.1 before 0.99.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the cloud sync API chatsMessages.update handler, which leaves the client-supplied chatId writable. Authenticated Pro subscribers who know another user's chat ID can move messages with arbitrary parts and metadata into the victim's AI chat history.

summary: WHartTest 2.2.0 through 2.8.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in...

Attackers can set project_pk to another project's sequential ID to modify, delete, or trigger scheduled tasks via run-now and read execution logs.

summary: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the chart feature of SharePoint...
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the chart feature of SharePoint Manager Plus (SPMP) due to improper sanitization and HTML encoding of user-controlled data. An attacker can inject malicious HTML or JavaScript into attributes used to generate charts, including users' full names, site names, or group names. The injected content is stored and subsequently executed in the context of other users' browsers when the affected charts are rendered. This vulnerability was fixed in client application build 4508.

summary: Songloft 2.9.0 before 2.13.6 contains a hardcoded credentials vulnerability that allows adjacent...

Attackers on the same network can log in via the /api/v1/auth/login endpoint to modify library and configuration settings and install JavaScript plugins running in QuickJS.

summary: MuseBot before 2.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated...
description: MuseBot before 2.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge admin sessions by using the hard-coded default session_key 'muse_bot_session_key'. Attackers can sign a MuseBot-session cookie carrying a user_id to gain full administrative access, reading password hashes, chat records, and bot configuration, and stopping bots.

description: PowerDNS-Admin through 2026.08.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated User-role accounts to refresh secondary zones they cannot access by supplying a different 'domain' field in the JSON body. Attackers authorized for any one zone can force axfr-retrieve transfers of other users' secondary zones and infer zone existence from differing responses.

Anonymous attackers can inject subqueries that bypass SqlSugar's field check to extract member accounts and orders through boolean-based or time-based blind techniques.

Attackers can supply another user's folder id to /folder/info, /folder/upd, /folder/open or /folder/del to read storage paths, rename, toggle visibility, or delete folders.

summary: ShowDoc through 3.9.5 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the api/paramDescLib...
description: ShowDoc through 3.9.5 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the api/paramDescLib/deleteEntries endpoint that checks edit permission only for the first supplied entry id. Authenticated attackers can place their own entry id first and append other users' entry ids to permanently delete those parameter-description entries.

summary: FilePress through 3.0.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in dzz/pichome/library...
description: FilePress through 3.0.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in dzz/pichome/library that allows authenticated users to manage other libraries' folders because checkuserperm_by_uid only checks membership of any library. Attackers who know another library's appid or folder id can invoke folder.php operations like deletefolder and rename, or rightdata.php getfolderdata, to delete, modify, or read foreign folders.

summary: Nging through 5.3.5 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows any...

Low-privileged users without file-manager permission can supply arbitrary paths in the query parameter to enumerate directories readable by the Nging process and confirm specific files exist.

Attackers can send GET or POST requests to /privacy with a target uid parameter to read and overwrite that user's UserPrivacy settings without ownership checks.

summary: DataCap through 2025.1.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any...

Attackers can send GET requests to /user/friend/page with a victim's uid, bypassing the missing administrator or owner check to read any user's contact list.

summary: Orchard CMS 1.10.3 through 1.11 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in...

summary: Blossom through 1.17.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated...

Attackers can call the picture delete, /picture/del/batch, or /picture/star endpoints to permanently delete victims' images and stored files or change their star status.

summary: Tencent BlueKing CMDB (bk-cmdb) through 3.14.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability...
description: Tencent BlueKing CMDB (bk-cmdb) through 3.14.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to view hosts of other businesses via POST /api/v3/hosts/search/asstdetail. Attackers can submit host search conditions targeting other businesses or omitting business filters to retrieve host attributes and topology association details, because the route is mapped to SkipAction and SearchHostWithAsstDetail skips AuthorizeSearchHost.

summary: Open Web Analytics before 1.14.1 contains an authorization vulnerability that allows...
description: Open Web Analytics before 1.14.1 contains an authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read other sites' report data because clickstream and transaction reports are not scoped to the authorized siteId. Users with view_reports on one site can supply that siteId with another site's session_id or order_id to read its visit history, IP addresses, user agents and order data.
